title: Sparkly spinning top
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg' font-family='sans-serif'>
  <!-- Sparkles -->
  <g fill='#FFE44D'>
    <path d='M15 20 L17 26 L23 28 L17 30 L15 36 L13 30 L7 28 L13 26 Z'/>
    <path d='M82 15 L84 20 L89 22 L84 24 L82 29 L80 24 L75 22 L80 20 Z'/>
    <path d='M85 65 L87 70 L92 72 L87 74 L85 79 L83 74 L78 72 L83 70 Z'/>
    <path d='M16 72 L18 77 L23 79 L18 81 L16 86 L14 81 L9 79 L14 77 Z'/>
    <path d='M50 8 L52 13 L57 15 L52 17 L50 22 L48 17 L43 15 L48 13 Z' fill='#FFF176'/>
  </g>

  <!-- Small dot sparkles -->
  <g fill='#FFD54F'>
    <circle cx='30' cy='50' r='2'/>
    <circle cx='70' cy='45' r='2'/>
    <circle cx='25' cy='60' r='1.5'/>
    <circle cx='78' cy='55' r='1.5'/>
    <circle cx='40' cy='12' r='1.5'/>
    <circle cx='62' cy='85' r='2'/>
  </g>

  <!-- Top body - main cone -->
  <path d='M35 42 Q50 38 65 42 L58 65 Q50 72 42 65 Z' fill='#E53935'/>
  <!-- Cone shading -->
  <path d='M42 65 Q50 72 58 65 L54 55 Q50 58 46 55 Z' fill='#B71C1C'/>

  <!-- Top cap / handle -->
  <rect x='46' y='22' width='8' height='20' rx='4' fill='#FFB300'/>
  <rect x='46' y='22' width='4' height='20' rx='2' fill='#FFCA28'/>

  <!-- Cap knob -->
  <circle cx='50' cy='22' r='6' fill='#FFB300'/>
  <circle cx='50' cy='21' r='3' fill='#FFECB3'/>

  <!-- Top rim / disc -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='42' rx='22' ry='6' fill='#43A047'/>
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='41' rx='22' ry='5' fill='#66BB6A'/>
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='43' rx='18' ry='4' fill='#2E7D32'/>

  <!-- Stripe on cone -->
  <path d='M38 52 Q50 56 62 52 L60 58 Q50 61 40 58 Z' fill='#FFEB3B'/>

  <!-- Bottom tip -->
  <path d='M46 65 Q50 75 54 65 Z' fill='#FF7043'/>
  <circle cx='50' cy='72' r='2.5' fill='#FFCA28'/>

  <!-- Motion lines -->
  <g stroke='#4DD0E1' stroke-width='1.5' stroke-linecap='round' fill='none' opacity='0.8'>
    <path d='M22 40 Q18 42 22 44'/>
    <path d='M78 40 Q82 42 78 44'/>
    <path d='M20 53 Q16 55 20 57'/>
    <path d='M80 53 Q84 55 80 57'/>
  </g>

  <!-- Top highlight -->
  <ellipse cx='46' cy='46' rx='4' ry='6' fill='#FF8A80' opacity='0.5'/>
</svg>
